work.title: Integrate signals into Spec discovery
work.description: Update codepatrol-spec so Discovery and Backlog Review consume the structured improvement output before proposing: inspect the graph, inspect signals, inspect supporting evidence for selected patterns, propose, validate, and require normal approval and apply.
acceptance: Spec distinguishes observed signals from its interpretation
Proposed improvement Works cite supporting Works and patterns
Spec never applies an improvement Initiative automatically
Suggestions without sufficient evidence are marked as hypotheses
Duplicate improvement Works are detected against the current graph
